title: Lane/Quotes
summary:
"That door would open only for a Casterwill. She belongs here."
- Lane to Dellix about Sophie Casterwill (Memory Lane)

"You think you can do it without your chaperones then?"
- Lane to Sophie Casterwill, about the solo mission (Chasing Void)

"The kid is honest enough, but I'm not sure we can trust that Zhalia woman."
- Lane about Zhalia Moon and Lok Lambert (Chasing Void)

"And we make a pretty good team."
-Lane to the Huntik team, about their fight with the Organization (Chasing Void)

"But together we're one of the strongest Casterwill squads. We should be helping!"
- Lane to Lucas Casterwill (The Spiral War)
